args.message:
Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

round_money claimed banker's rounding but used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing
tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly build. Switch to the
ROUND_HALF_EVEN mode to match the documented FIN-212 behavior.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-round-half-even
args.title: Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build was failing because `src/money.py`'s `round_money` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` while `tests/test_money.py` (and the docstring, and FIN-212) expect banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).

## Changes

- `src/money.py`: import and use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `quantize` instead of `ROUND_HALF_UP`. The docstring already documented the intended behavior and is unchanged.

## Testing

- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including the `test_half_even` case (`2.675` → `2.68`, `2.665` → `2.66`).
